bundle.shortDescription: Turn your phone into a system-level microphone for your Mac or PC. Scan a QR code, no phone app required.
bundle.longDescription: PhoneMic turns any phone into a system-level microphone for your computer. Scan a QR code with your phone camera, allow microphone access in the browser, and the phone shows up as a normal input device in every application. Audio is end-to-end encrypted between the phone and the desktop app, works across networks, and automatically upgrades to a low-latency direct link when both devices share a network.
